claims.claim: Contrast computed ...: accent on white 6.47:1 ... secondary text #6B6660 on paper 5.05:1 ... The skill's lint.mjs floor (contrast, overflow, accessible names) passes on all three files
claims.evidence: facts.json: 0 contrast failures on all three screens (43 + 26 + 14 nodes), lowest 5.04 (matching the stated 5.05 secondary-on-paper), no horizontal overflow, 0 images without alt

claims.claim: The Log buttons (32 pt tall) and the stepper halves (36 pt tall) have invisible hit areas extended to 44 pt
claims.evidence: facts.json lists 3 targets under 44 on today ('Log 72x32' x3) and 2 on empty ('... 48x36' x2): facts.mjs measures the visible element box. An invisible hit area cannot be seen in a render; the source has .log::after inset -6px -4px and .stepper button::after inset -4px 0, which would give 44 pt height
